faq_heading: New construction in Brentwood Park: your questions answered

faq.q: What have condos in Brentwood Park sold for?
faq.a: 490 condos sold in Brentwood Park at a median of $693,750, with the middle half between $577,625 and $813,750.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in Brentwood Park?
faq.a: In Brentwood Park, townhomes were quickest at 16 days at a median, and condos slowest at 27 days.

faq.q: Which homes in Brentwood Park are the newest?
faq.a: Of the homes that resold in Brentwood Park, condos had the newest median build year, 2020.

blocks.text: The search above lists active MLS® listings in Brentwood Park where the board's age field reads 0 or less: homes finished this year, and homes listed ahead of completion. Houses, townhomes and condos are in; land and income properties are not. Over November 2025 to October 2026, the busiest home type in Brentwood Park was condos: 490 sales at a median of $693,750, and 3 types had 5 or more sales.

items.t: In Brentwood Park, houses sold at a median of $1,750,000 across 20 sales, and the middle half closed between $1,644,989 and $1,958,500. The median house sat 24 days and sold for 97.2% of list.
Brentwood Park: 14 townhomes sold at a median of $1,070,000, with the middle half between $878,350 and $1,236,000. The median townhome took 16 days to sell and closed at 98.3% of list.
490 condos sold in Brentwood Park at a median of $693,750 (middle half $577,625 to $813,750). A typical condo in Brentwood Park spent 27 days on the market and closed at 96.9% of the asking price.

blocks.text: 4 Duplexes also sold in Brentwood Park, too few for a median to mean anything, so no price is shown for them.
Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Brentwood Park compares with the rest of Burnaby North

items.t: Houses in Brentwood Park have the 9th highest median of 11 Burnaby North sub-areas, $1,750,000. Central BN is lowest at $1,650,000 and Government Road highest at $2,380,000. Willingdon Heights ($1,704,000) sits just below and Westridge BN ($1,840,000) sits just above.

Of 10 Burnaby North sub-areas with 5 or more townhome sales, Brentwood Park ranks second highest at $1,070,000; the range is $765,000 (Central BN) to $1,090,000 (Willingdon Heights). Sullivan Heights ($1,044,000) sits just below and Willingdon Heights ($1,090,000) sits just above.
Condos in Brentwood Park have the highest median of the 8 Burnaby North sub-areas, $693,750, ahead of Capitol Hill BN at $617,500; the lowest is Cariboo at $440,900.

blocks.text: By build year, condos are the newest homes selling in Brentwood Park (median 2020) and houses the oldest (median 1958), a gap of 62 years.
